title: Token bucket rate limiter on a monotonic clock
source: Authored for the CodeReview benchmark corpus (expanded clean stratum), 2026-11-05
false_flag_note: A reviewer may flag updating the refill timestamp even when a request is denied as a bug. It is the standard lazy-refill accounting: elapsed time is converted to tokens (capped at capacity) and the timestamp advances on every call, granted or denied, so tokens can neither be double-counted nor lost. The clock is monotonic, so NTP adjustments cannot mint or burn tokens, and the whole check-and-deduct is atomic under the lock.
